h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shimoga

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shimoga

items.pText: Shimoga stands at the edge of the Malnad region of Karnataka, where the western ghats bring a long and heavy monsoon. The ground under a playground stays wet for months, so the choice of surface matters as much as the equipment. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, societies and parks in Shimoga, made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 670 km away.

The city sits on the Tunga river and is the gateway to Jog Falls and the Malnad hill towns. Rain is heavier towards the ghats and lighter on the eastern side of the district. Share the size of your site, the age group and a few photos taken in the rainy season if you have them. We will suggest equipment and a surface, and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing the surface under the equipment

c: Grass looks good in a dry month, but under swings and slides it wears to mud within weeks of the monsoon starting. Sand cushions falls when dry, but it packs hard when wet, washes away in heavy rain and needs regular topping up. Bare concrete or stone is unsafe under any play equipment.

Rubber flooring on a compacted, drained base handles Shimoga's rain best. Water runs off quickly, the surface stays usable soon after a shower and falls are cushioned. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment. Give the base a slight slope towards a drain. For nearby towns, see our pages for

items.q: Is grass a good surface under playground equipment?
items.a: Not in a wet area. Grass under swings and slides wears away quickly and turns to mud in the monsoon. Rubber flooring on a drained base lasts longer and cushions falls.
Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas along with our equipment. Tell us the size of the area and we will include it in the layout and quote.

items.q: Do you install in Shimoga district?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
